result.title: Learning to Design Convex Relaxations for Nonconvex Optimization
result.summary: Convex relaxations make nonconvex optimization tractable by replacing hard nonconvex problems with convex surrogates that give valid bounds. Yet their design is still largely manual: a human expert must decide where to relax, which relaxation to use, and how much formulation growth is worth paying. We show that this design process can be learned. The method proposed in this paper, AutoConvexRelax, represents the symbolic formulation of a nonconvex problem as a tripartite graph linking variables, symbolic terms, and their objective or constraint positions. It then learns a policy that composes symbolic rewrites into problem-specific relaxation trajectories as the formulation evolves. We prove that finite action sequences generated by the learned policy preserve relaxation validity under explicit domain, occurrence-context, and representation-consistency conditions. We further establish computable error bounds for mixed relaxations and sufficient conditions for feasible recovery and global-optimality certification. As a first instantiation, we apply the method to nonconvex quadratic problems and fractional problems. On 241 benchmark quadratic instances, the learned policy strengthens McCormick lower bounds by 13.52%. Its mean lower bound is 3.70% below strengthened semidefinite relaxations on the normalized comparison metric, while it uses substantially smaller formulations. The learned policy retains this trade-off on fractional instances and reaches near-semidefinite bounds on beamforming and sensor-network localization instances. These results suggest that convex relaxation design can move from a fixed handcrafted choice to an automated learning process that adapts to problem structures. Code is available at https://github.com/auto4opt/AutoConvexRelax.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 AutoConvexRelax，把非凸问题的符号形式化表示为「变量—符号项—目标/约束位置」的三部图，学习一个把符号重写组合成问题特定松弛轨迹的策略，并证明所生成有限动作序列在若干一致性条件下保持松弛有效性、给出误差界与全局最优认证条件。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「在演变中的符号状态上逐步施加变换、并为每步变换给出显式有效性条件」的设定，可能为 LVR 的 latent 轨迹生成与逐步监督/验证设计提供类比线索（如状态抽象、轨迹合法性论证、形式化增长与收益的权衡），但领域距离较远，是否可迁移需人工核查。
